About 2ACE

Run by people who have made, sold and shipped goods themselves.

2ACE is a partnership between a Chinese and an Egyptian partner. We bring a long history in manufacturing, sales and operations, and we live and work in China and in Poland, so your goods are looked after at both ends of the journey.

Build your planBook a call

We have stood where you stand

We have made products, sold them and run the operations behind them. We know what it feels like when goods leave the factory and then disappear into customs, a courier network or a warehouse where nobody picks up the phone.

That is why 2ACE is built the way it is: space you can see and count, every movement of your stock recorded, problems reported to you with photos, and a price you can read online before you talk to anyone.

We are not a landlord renting you shelves. We are operators who want your business to run smoothly, because that is the only reason you would stay.

One of us in China, one of us in Poland

Goods are made and shipped in one country, then stored, picked and delivered from another. We are present at both ends, so nothing in the middle is left to chance.

China

Where goods are made and sent from

One of us lives in China, close to suppliers and factories, and to the people who ship your goods. Questions about production, dates and what is on the truck get answered by someone who is actually there.

Poland

Where goods are stored and delivered from

The other lives in Poland, on the ground in the EU: your space, receiving, customs paperwork, packing and shipping. When something needs a person to walk over and look, that person is nearby.

What that means for you

01

No gap between factory and shelf

The people who talk to your supplier and the people who receive your goods work together, so a delay or a mistake is caught early instead of discovered on arrival.

02

Operators, not just storage

Orders received before 15:00 ship the same day. Returns are inspected and graded within 48 hours. Damaged or unexpected goods are photographed and reported to you by email.

03

Your own space, counted

You rent square metres that are assigned to you alone, and you see your stock, deliveries and orders in your dashboard. Every movement is recorded.

04

Prices you can read

Storage from 300 zł per m² per month, priced online, with no minimum term. Resize or cancel with 30 days notice. VAT is shown separately.

05

A way into the EU

For sellers outside Europe we handle import and customs help, storage in Poland, shipping to your customers and returns, so you can sell in the EU without setting up a warehouse of your own.

06

People who answer

Write to hello@2ace.pl or call us. You talk to the people who run the operation, not a ticket queue.

See what it costs in two minutes

Choose your space and the services you need, watch the monthly price update, then sign and pay online. If you would rather talk first, book a call in English, Chinese or Arabic. No account needed.
